endpoint_definition: Growth more turbid than its own ancestor at the published endpoint assay (Table 1 footnote a); no-rescue means not meeting this endpoint, not no possible biochemical function.
source_locator: Results: Experimental evolution restores growth; Table 1 and footnotes a-f
source_checks: Table 1 rows verified against publisher-indexed full text and PMC-indexed table.

limitations: Gene-specific events are alternatives, not independent outcome samples.
